insights.topic: Deterministic purchase proof vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: Each of the 6,607 verified receipts is a confirmed purchase event — not an inferred intent signal. Ad tech charges $5–$150 CPA to model conversions that this protocol settles for ~$0.10 per cryptographically signed receipt, a 50–200x cost delta that isn't a pricing advantage but a structural difference in what's being sold.

Chrome's cookie deprecation eliminates the primary cross-site tracking primitive that ad tech attribution is built on; device fingerprinting and data brokers remain probabilistic and face tightening GDPR/CCPA exposure. Verified receipt data sidesteps the attribution problem entirely because the receipt is the conversion event, not a downstream inference from it.

insights.topic: Physical commerce dominance in verified GMV
insights.insight: Grocery, dining, and gas account for 56% of receipts in the 14-day window — categories where brand marketers have historically had the weakest closed-loop attribution. Walmart alone generated 86 verified receipts in 14 days, with Costco and Target also in the top five, confirming the signal set covers mass-market physical retail, not just digital transactions.

Active receipt submission spans 21 CBSAs with documented expansion into non-metro AZ, CA, FL, IA, KY, MA, ME, MN, NC, NJ, WV, and WI — not concentrated in top-10 media markets. The diffusion pattern is consistent with organic social-graph spread, which tends to produce more representative consumer panels than market-by-market campaign rollouts.

Whole Foods Market entered the top brand list for the first time on 2026-03-28, the first new brand to appear in recent cycles. For CPG and premium grocery marketers, this is an early indicator that the verified receipt panel is beginning to capture higher-income purchase behavior alongside mass-market retail.

insights.topic: Velocity-acceleration divergence as a leading indicator
insights.insight: Absolute receipt throughput velocity has stayed below 1.0x for 9+ consecutive cycles while acceleration has stayed above 1.0x for the same stretch — meaning the growth rate is compounding even as single-cycle volume appears suppressed. The lowest velocity reading (0.641x) was immediately followed by the highest acceleration reading (1.039x) and an 8-CBSA geographic burst, suggesting quiet cycles precede expansion rather than signal decay.
